description: List recent commits on a branch including file-level diff content for each commit

branchName.description: Branch name to list commits from

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository

skip.description: Number of commits to skip from the newest

top.description: Maximum number of commits to return (Default: 10)

name: list_commits
